column1: # Each FT-02 group's gzipped wasm beside the default profile's
# release.yml's npm job builds the default profile, `wasm-pack build --release
# --target web --out-dir pkg bindings/js` under `RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings`, a
# group's with a scratch feature carrying the WOFF2 forms its census `group`
# row counts, each counted by `gzip -9 -c bindings/js/pkg/tinker_pdf_js_bg.wasm
# | wc -c`, all of one revision; the run's revision, machine and day are in the
# message of the commit that wrote it.
